evidence.visualGalleryFinding: The closest pairs are recognizably the same macro layout at gameplay-thumbnail scale; the shared road skeleton is the dominant repeated landmark.
evidence.randomGalleryFinding: The locked simple/open Crownlands art direction remains readable and coherent across all four themes.
evidence.foundationFinding: Three plates per theme remain acceptable when combined with transforms, tone profiles, roads, perimeter choices, and unique accent placement.
evidence.perimeterFinding: Sixty-four full perimeter combinations with a 2.01 percent maximum use share remain acceptable; no additional perimeter art is presently justified.
evidence.accentFinding: All 10000 accent placement plans are unique; additional accents remain unjustified.

minimumEvidenceBasedNextStep.reason: The benchmark demonstrates road-geometry under-utilization before it demonstrates a shortage of road artwork.
minimumEvidenceBasedNextStep.requiredRevalidation: Repeat the 10000-map similarity and sampled visual gates after the development-only road-selection change.

conditionalFallbackOnly.condition: Use only if cross-theme geometry harmonization cannot preserve the locked regional art style.
